description: This file contains functions for converting a lead into other entities such as Accounts, Contacts, and Potentials within the vtiger CRM system, including handling related records and updating statuses.

methods.name: vtws_convertlead
methods.description: Main function to convert a lead into other entities, handling creation, relation updates, and status changes.

methods.name: vtws_populateConvertLeadEntities
methods.description: Populates entity fields with lead info, ensuring mandatory fields are filled.

methods.name: vtws_validateConvertLeadEntityMandatoryValues
methods.description: Ensures all mandatory fields are populated, assigning defaults or placeholders.

methods.name: vtws_getConvertLeadFieldInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information for a specific field in a module.

methods.name: vtws_convertLeadTransferHandler
methods.description: Handles transfer of related records during lead conversion.

methods.name: vtws_updateConvertLeadStatus
methods.description: Marks the lead as converted and cleans up related records.
